sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A preserved snapshot of a particular state of a document.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Keep yesterday’s edition as well as today’s edition so old quotations remain explainable.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Version 1 says “supports X”; version 2 says “supports Y.” Old evidence still points to version 1.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Changed content, source revision, processing or authorization can produce a new immutable version. Exact retries are unchanged.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Overwriting would erase the context that supported an earlier assertion.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Version metadata includes title and source URI identity. F1 is scoped to metadata hash integrity, not blanket ingestion verification.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
